_readme: Intentional differences the consistency tests should accept. Add an entry only after deciding the difference is correct, and always give the reason. Key formats: '<generatorId>.<controlId>.<label|min|max|default|unit>', '<generatorId>.<controlId>.missing', 'asset-version.<file name>'. Example: { "key": "data-matrix.scale.max", "reason": "2D modules are small; needs a larger max scale" }
